intro.title: What is Top Rentals Club?
intro.text: It's our loyalty program. Every time you stay at Top Rentals, you earn points you can redeem for discounts, upgrades, and exclusive benefits on your next stays.

steps.title: Book with Top Rentals
steps.text: Every confirmed stay earns points automatically.

steps.title: Earn points
steps.text: Your points are credited when each reservation ends.

steps.title: Level up
steps.text: The more nights per year, the more benefits you unlock.

steps.title: Redeem
steps.text: Use your points for discounts and upgrades on future stays.

levels.title: Club levels
levels.subtitle: The more you return, the more benefits you unlock.

columns.title: Earning and redemption
items: Points don't expire while you stay active

items.question: How do I join the Club?
items.answer: Sign up for free with your email. Your membership activates automatically with your first booking.

items.question: Do points expire?
items.answer: No. Your points accumulate with no expiration date as long as your account is active.

items.question: How do I level up?
items.answer: Your level is based on nights accumulated in a calendar year. More nights mean more benefits.

items.question: Can I redeem points at any property?
items.answer: Yes, at all Top Rentals properties in Buenos Aires and Quito.

bottomCta.text: Your next booking already earns points. Joining is free and automatic.
